ns2:section.sectionText: Prerequisites strictly enforced. Priority registration given to Juniors and Seniors majoring in Hospitality Mgmt. Juniors and Seniors majoring in Dietetics can register at the start of Sophomore registration. HM students have priority registration for spring, and dietetics students have priority registration for fall.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Dietetics or Hospitality Management concentration(s). Restricted to students with Junior or Senior class standing.
